title: Page 347
transc:
Ft Monroe Jan. 29 - 1865
Maj. Eckert , Washington
Imogene for Burton growl unity The boats have returned
having gone as far up Pagan Creek as the
ice would allow being very thick unity Saw no
appearance of walnuts or boats zodiac During the nights
saw many signals by fires ditto on wed niece
day Shelby Shepley desires the Cooper a shun of
a nay v faint sligo same direction which I
shall give webster Joseph Land man Comma door &c.
Geo. D. Sheldon


Annapolis 8 P. M. Jan. 31 - 1865
Sheldon Ft Monroe
very sorry I missed train by forgetting penfield book arrived
at wharf just as the weasler had left every thing
appears right so far excepting too many pupils about office
will look to interests of the service and carry out
any instructions you may give to my best ability finis
9 P. m. To Maj. Eckert  Baldwin


Ft Monroe Feb. 1 - 1865
S. H. Beckwith City Point
Susan for John Black zebra I arrived here at
feeble this evening and shall remain here to meet
the persons from garden unity Send Taunton Eckert here
if he is with you yoke Byron yours truly
Geo. D. Sheldon
